cross_domain_structural_analogy.principle: A path-dependent interior safety statistic can be genuinely local only by leaving a later-path residual; deleting that residual silently turns local analysis into an endpoint claim.

explicit_disanalogies: A synthetic signed-increment path is not an admissible alternative von Mangoldt sequence and cannot serve as an arithmetic counterexample.
A bound on Q_n does not imply a bound on G_n.
A bound on Q_n and G_n that yields a root-sensitive endpoint lower bound may itself be root-strength; decomposition does not lower total proof strength.
